LanguageData.FB_ColonyBrain_Structure_FleshBaitPod_De: Grows a lure sprout that hungry wild animals can eat. If a wild animal begins feeding and a colony heart has a free grasping slot, the pod binds the prey with root tendrils.
LanguageData.FB_FleshBaitPod_ReleasePreyDesc: Release the held prey and free the colony heart's grasping slot.
